status.current: puppet body destroyed by Stella; disqualified for malicious foul because real person was not on the field

personality.summary: Mocking, sadistic and utterly pragmatic; he treats matches as jobs and people as controllable objects rather than opponents deserving honor.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Attempts to break her by taking Mikoto hostage; Stella responds by treating him as trash rather than a knight.
relationships.mikoto-tsuruya: Turns her into his human puppet by threading her brain and forcing her ability beyond safe limits.
relationships.yui-tatara: Authorizes Tatara to use lethal force in the special match.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Uses Charlotte and Rinna's struggle to buy time for his own puppets.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Ikki senses his ominous concentration while watching the match.

periods.summary: Hiraga oversees Akatsuki's side of Stella's special match and saves his own preparations while others fight. He assembles a giant rubble puppet, Deus Ex Machina, from derelict urban material, then reveals his deeper trap: while Stella fought Charlotte, he threaded Mikoto Tsuruya's brain and made her a puppet, removing her self-preservation so her Deadly Ice Smile becomes far stronger. Using Mikoto as a hostage, he tries to force Stella to abandon combat. This tactic instead makes Stella discard her sword out of contempt and unleash Brute Dragon Roar in fantasy form, melting the arena and destroying both Deus Ex Machina and Hiraga's puppet body. His real body was never present, leading to disqualification.

key_events.summary: Uses Deus Ex Machina and Marionette after his teammates fall.
Is destroyed by Stella's Brute Dragon Roar after threatening Mikoto.
